name: Guangdong Topstar Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Topstar Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the design, research and development, manufacture, and sale of industrial robots in China. The company offers injection molding machines; injection robots; auxiliary equipment; CNC machines; and industrial robots, including SCARA series, six-axis multi-joint series, parallel multi-joint series, and collaborative series.
